rust_summary: a living entity about to die, cancellable (`native_living_death`).
doc_summary: a living entity about to die, as NeoForge's `LivingDeathEvent`: `native_living_death(entity, kind, damage_type, attacker, cancel)` runs on the server when a mob's or a server player's health has run out, before the death runs (loot, experience, death message). Cancelling keeps the entity alive at 1 health. Bundles need "hooks": @API:living_death@.
